$comment: Lip sync v1 thresholds for lib/lipsync-volume.mjs. FROZEN since prompt #17 (rig/frozen.json). Chosen values, not measurements (author's prompts #14 and #16). Loudness is the RMS of one frame's samples, linear, full scale 1.
howChosen: Chosen again on the processed P1-P3 of the chosen voice (author's prompt #16; npm run lipsync:stats, out/lipsync-stats.txt), with the same rule as before: 48 of 151 frames are under 0.0075 (silence and breath) and the next louder frame is 0.01064, so restBelow stays 0.01, in that gap; openFrom 0.07 opens the mouth on the loudest fifth: 32 of 151 frames are at 0.07 or above (0.2119205298013245 of them; with the provisional voice 46 of 219 frames, 0.2100456621004566, were at 0.08 or above).

before.howChosen: Chosen after looking at the RMS of every frame (30 fps) of P1, P2 and P3 with the provisional voice (npm run lipsync:stats, out/lipsync-stats.txt): 66 of 219 frames are under 0.005 and 10 more under 0.01 (silence and breath); speech sits from about 0.02 up; 46 frames are at 0.08 or above (the loud vowels). restBelow 0.01 (about -40 dBFS) puts silence at rest; openFrom 0.08 (about -22 dBFS) opens the mouth only on the loudest fifth. To be chosen again once the author has picked the voice.
